servicesPage.title: Services
servicesPage.description: Four Epicxstudios products: a K12 curriculum platform, a training LMS, custom applications, and education websites.
servicesPage.headline: The platform first. Then the program around it.
servicesPage.lede: K12 content for state and CBSE syllabi is the center. Training for higher study, engineering, nursing, and medicine sits with it. Custom applications and websites carry those platforms into a classroom and onto a public page.

about.title: About
about.description: Epicxstudios builds curriculum platforms for state and CBSE classrooms, and training systems for higher study.
about.headline: A studio for the syllabus, and the systems that carry it.
about.lede: Epicxstudios builds the K12 platform first: state and CBSE content, classrooms, and a place for teachers to add their own work. The same studio builds training systems for higher education, engineering, nursing, and medical programs, then the applications and websites those programs need.

principles.title: The syllabus is the spec.
principles.body: State boards and CBSE set the path. The platform follows the chapter, the period, and the exam the class is preparing for.

principles.title: Teachers keep the room.
principles.body: A studio for their own material, a library where they create it, and classrooms they open themselves. The course can grow after it is installed.

principles.title: One course, several screens.
principles.body: A phone, a PC, a tablet, and an AR/VR device open the same lesson. The room chooses the screen. The chapter stays put.

principles.title: Training past the school.
principles.body: Higher education, engineering, nursing, and medical programs use the same discipline: a cohort, a curriculum, and a record of what was practiced.

about.teamLede: The names stay off this page. Each seat is a part of the work: the syllabus, the classroom, the training programs, and the applications and sites around them.
about.productsTitle: Four products, one classroom at the start.

practices.title: K12 curriculum
practices.headline: The syllabus, on a platform teachers can extend.
practices.summary: A curriculum LMS for state syllabi and CBSE, with a studio, a library, and classrooms teachers open themselves.
practices.lede: The main product is a learning platform for K12. Lessons follow state syllabi and CBSE, and the same course opens on a phone, a PC, a tablet, or an AR/VR device. Teachers extend it themselves: a studio for material they add, a library where they create it, and classrooms they open for their own students.
points: Syllabus-aligned lessons for state boards and CBSE, so a chapter can be the period a class runs today.
One course on mobile, PC, tablets, and AR/VR devices. The room picks the screen. The chapter stays the same.
A studio for material teachers add, a library where they create it, and classrooms they set up themselves.

details.title: Studio
details.body: Teachers add their own lessons, files, and checks. The course can grow after it is installed, without waiting on a new release from the studio.

details.title: Library
details.body: A place to create content and keep it. A department can draft a lesson once and reuse it across sections that share the same syllabus.

details.title: Classrooms
details.body: A teacher opens a class, assigns the syllabus path, and works with the students in that room. The roster and the lesson stay together.

details.title: Devices
details.body: Phones, computers, tablets, and AR/VR headsets open the same course. The room picks the screen. The chapter stays the same.

practices.title: Training LMS
practices.headline: A training platform for the programs after school.
practices.summary: An LMS for higher education, engineering, nursing, and medical training, and for other domains that teach by practice.
practices.lede: The second product is a training LMS. It is built for higher education and for domains that teach by doing: engineering, nursing, and medical education, and other programs that need a cohort, a curriculum, and a record. The course, the group, and the assessment live in one place.
points: Programs for colleges and institutes, structured as terms, modules, and the assessments those programs already use.
Engineering, nursing, and medical training, where a lab, a ward, or a procedure is part of the lesson.
The same LMS shape for other training domains. A new field starts from a cohort and a curriculum already in place.

details.title: Higher education
details.body: Courses and cohorts for colleges and institutes. Faculty can see the term, the module, and who has finished the work.

details.title: Engineering
details.body: Labs, drawings, and problem sets stay attached to the module they belong to. Practice lives in the course.

details.title: Nursing and medicine
details.body: Training sequences a learner can repeat, with a record of what was practiced and finished. The platform carries the program the institute already teaches.

details.title: Other domains
details.body: Any training field that needs a curriculum, a cohort, and a record can use the same shape. The syllabus changes. The platform holds.

practices.title: Custom applications
practices.headline: Applications for the work around the course.
practices.summary: Custom software and mobile products for schools, institutes, and the teams that run a training platform.
practices.lede: When the LMS is not the whole job, the studio builds the applications around it. A student app, a faculty tool, enrollment, content operations, support. The software is for training and education, and it is held to the same standard as the course.
points: Mobile and desktop applications for the people who teach, learn, and run the program.
Tools for enrollment, content operations, and support, sitting with the LMS.
Shaped for school and institute networks: shared devices, interrupted connections, and a release a team can stage.

details.title: Student and teacher apps
details.body: Applications for phones, tablets, and computers. The person in the lesson and the person running it each get a tool that matches the work.

details.title: Operations
details.body: Enrollment, content operations, and support tools for the team behind the program. They share the same records as the course.

details.title: The network in the building
details.body: Shared devices, connections that drop, and releases a small team can stage. The application has to keep working on the day the lab is full.

practices.title: Education websites
practices.headline: Sites that can explain the program.
practices.summary: Websites for training platforms, schools, and institutes in education.
practices.lede: The public site is how a school, an institute, or a training platform explains the program. It names the syllabus, the people who teach, and how someone starts. It stays fast when the content is real.
points: Sites for training platforms: the product, the program, and a clear way to begin.
Sites for schools and education groups, written around the syllabus and the faculty.
Exact type, a readable structure, and motion kept off the path a visitor is reading.
practices.detailTitle: Pages with a program behind them.

details.title: Training platforms
details.body: A public site for the product itself. Who it is for, how a course runs, and where a school or an institute starts.

details.title: Schools and institutes
details.body: Pages a family, a student, or a partner can read: the syllabus, the faculty, and the program, in that order.

details.title: The reading path
details.body: Type and structure come first. Motion stays off the sentences. The site has to hold when the syllabus and the cohort are both on the page.
